description: How the port handles each Cursor-only name in upstream's TERMS list (vendor/cursor-plugins/scripts/generate-pstack-harness-trees.mjs). scripts/check_cursor_terms.py fails when upstream adds a name missing here, or when a translated name survives into the generated package. translated: must not appear in generated Markdown. kept: valid as-is in Codex. gap: known untranslated upstream usage, allowed but reported on every check.

`Task`.reason: Rewritten to subagent and task vocabulary.

todolist.reason: A todo list is harness-neutral; Codex keeps a plan.

generalPurpose.reason: Rewritten to a standard Codex subagent.

poteto-agent.reason: The port ships a Codex custom agent with this name.

comment-sicko.reason: The port ships a Codex custom agent with this name.

`readonly: true`.reason: skills/why still says readonly/Ask mode; needs a Codex sandbox rewrite.

`environment: \"cloud\"`.reason: swarm and orchestrate still pass Cursor's cloud environment field; needs a Codex cloud-task or worktree rewrite.

cloud_base_branch.reason: swarm still names Cursor's cloud base-branch field.

`run_in_background: true`.reason: Rewritten to background Codex task wording.

`resume`.reason: Not used by upstream skills yet; add a rewrite before it ships.

`file_attachments`.reason: Not used by upstream skills yet; add a rewrite before it ships.

grok-.reason: Upstream model slugs map to Codex model slugs.

inherit-parent.reason: The port keeps the alias in pstack-models.toml.

agent-transcripts.reason: Transcript lookups still name Cursor's agent-transcripts folder; Codex keeps sessions under ~/.codex/sessions.
